skillset.skill: 14s CT - 2000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 10s, reduce enemies' Evasion rate and DMG RES by 20%.
skillset.arts:
For 20s, increase allies' Arts by 6/s and Allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 12000 DMG.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type B and will not stack with other Type B Arts Gen.
skillset.protagonize: Can be activated instead of Arts - Increase the final DMG dealt to allies and enemies by 1.5x.
skillset.truearts: 53000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 25s, reduce enemies' MAG RES by [100 + 20 x Current wave]% (MAX: 300%).
skillset.superarts: 130000% Dark DMG (MAG). Increase allies' (except self) Arts by 100. For 30s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 200%. When used for the first 2 times in a Quest, doubles both Arts UP and Dark RES debuff effects.

passive.ability1: Increase allies' MAX HP by 10%. Additionally if there is a non-Dark ally in party, increase allies' MAX HP by 20% instead. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Onyx's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Onyx's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 6000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 15s, increase own Dark DMG by 50%. If user is Human, increase own Dark DMG by 80% instead.
